title: Keep option help text out of the choices argument
answers: mitmweb crashes when I open options
How should an addon register multiline option help?
Why does option registration reject a string for choices?
body:
Symptom: mitmweb crashes when opening options.
Root cause: mitmproxy/addons/savehar.py:SaveHar.load passed a separate help-text string as the positional choices argument for hardump.
Fix pattern: Combine the complete description into one help argument; mitmproxy/addonmanager.py:Loader.add_option asserts that choices is not a string to catch this registration mistake.
Constraints: Applies to addon option registration; prose belongs in help, while choices must not be a bare string. The assertion does not prohibit actual choice collections.
applies: Addon option definitions registered through Loader.add_option, especially descriptions split across multiple lines.
